title: v0.45.0 Release - Performance and Terminal Improvements
description: Released v0.45.0 on June 3, 2026 with safer auto-updates, improved terminal and WSL handling, faster and more reliable core behavior, and new user actions.

community_feedback.quote: Gemini CLI stopping work from June 18, 2026, with users expressing concerns about feature parity

title: Transition to Usage-Based Billing with AI Credits
description: GitHub Copilot moved from flat-rate/request-based billing to usage-based billing using GitHub AI Credits. All plans now charge based on actual token consumption depending on the model used. Also introduced MAI-Code-1-Flash model, Copilot Max plan, pooled organization credits, and budget controls.

community_feedback.quote: Usage paying for AI is 1000x crazier 4.6 each dollar spent is 27 dollars in copilot AI Credits
GitHub just switched Copilot to metered billing, developers are watching months of credits vanish
Copilot Billing Shock Hits Developers - reports on developer complaints about unexpectedly rapid AI credit consumption

title: Market Position Update in June 2026
description: Aider maintains v0.86.2 as stable release with continued development. Recognized as best open-source CLI coding agent with 44k+ GitHub stars, git-first approach, and backend-agnostic flexibility supporting any LLM including local models via Ollama.

community_feedback.quote: The latest release works GREAT with gpt-5.3-codex
Developers continue to choose Aider in 2026 for its human-in-the-loop pair programming approach

title: Cloud Agent Handoff and Cursor SDK
description: June 10 update enabled pulling cloud agents back to local for testing with handoff between local and cloud. June 4 update introduced Custom stores, Custom tools, and Auto-review for the Cursor SDK.

title: Rebranded to Devin Desktop
description: On June 2, 2026, Cognition rebranded Windsurf to Devin Desktop. Existing users received an over-the-air update. Windsurf was kept available through July 1, 2026. After July 1, 2026, Devin Local became the only local agent option.

community_feedback.quote: Windsurf was rebranded to Devin Desktop, windsurf.ai redirects to Devin
As of February 2026 (pre-rebrand), Windsurf ranked #1 in LogRocket's AI Dev Tool Power Rankings, ahead of both Cursor and GitHub Copilot

title: Devin Desktop Launch
description: Cognition introduced Devin Desktop in June 2026, transforming the Windsurf interface into an agent command center. The AI-assisted automation input now shows incremental generating steps as it builds automation workflows. Users can manage fleets of local and cloud agents from one surface.

community_feedback.quote: Devin Desktop allows users to plan, delegate, review, and ship without leaving your editor

title: Acquired by Cursor - Final v2.0.0 Release
description: Continue.dev was acquired by Cursor in June 2026. Version 2.0.0 (June 19) is the final release of the open-source VS Code extension, CLI, and JetBrains plugin. The GitHub repository is now read-only. Final release removed telemetry, CLI banner, and Generate Rule feature.

community_feedback.quote: Woke up to an email saying continue.dev has been acquired by Cursor
Continue.Dev has taken some serious notes from Cursor, and I might cancel my Cursor subscription
Why the Cursor Acquisition Should Concern Every Software Developer
Cursor quietly acquires Continue, an open-source alternative - reports that this was a quiet acqui-hire that shut down the product

title: Trusted Devices Feature for Remote Control
description: Added Trusted Devices feature for Remote Control Admins on Team and Enterprise plans to verify devices before remote Claude Code sessions. Earlier June updates also included stronger auto-mode controls, better shell and MCP handling, richer background agent behavior, and improved debugging capabilities.

title: Codex Remote General Availability
description: Codex Remote reached general availability for connected Mac systems. June 25 update brought Codex CLI 0.x release with improved MCP tool search capabilities and stronger macOS proxy support. Broader ecosystem changes include GPT-5.5 integration, stable goal mode, and Chrome extension support.

community_feedback.quote: Codex CLI was rewritten from TypeScript to Rust in 2025-2026, with Rust builds shipping as maintained versions 0.128+
